profiles.label: Shanghai · public charging historical average
profiles.limitations: Historical public-network mean: electricity 0.68 and service 0.42 CNY/kWh. Not a station quote, not a current 2026 tariff and not a time-of-use schedule. Its flat reference profile cannot demonstrate time-shift savings.

profiles.label: Beijing · residential-area electricity reference
profiles.source_title: Beijing government residential charging fee FAQ
profiles.limitations: Electricity-only reference of 0.5103 CNY/kWh for the specified residential context. Service is market-priced and unknown here. Not a public fast-charging station price. Confirm the current meter classification.

profiles.label: Shijiazhuang / Hebei · residential time-of-use
profiles.basis: Official optional non-profit personal residential charging tariff
profiles.source_title: Shijiazhuang DRC reply to CPPCC proposal 0262
profiles.limitations: Optional residential ToU: 08:00–22:00 at 0.57, 22:00–08:00 at 0.31 CNY/kWh. Applies to non-profit personal residential use, not commercial public charging. The alternative flat combined-meter rate is 0.5362. No operator service fee is inferred.

profiles.label: Zhejiang · residential time-of-use below 1 kV
profiles.source_title: Zhejiang DRC and Market Regulation notice 316
profiles.limitations: Below-1-kV eligible residential charging: 08:00–22:00 at 0.588, 22:00–08:00 at 0.308 CNY/kWh; eligible first-category users may alternatively select 0.558 flat. Commercial facilities use different, market-based tariffs. Service is unknown. The official web page timed out during research; values were cross-checked against the published notice reproduction and an official Yiwu power-company FAQ.

profiles.label: Shenzhen · enter station prices
profiles.basis: Market-priced charging service; no universal city rate
profiles.source_title: Shenzhen DRC charging service fee FAQ
profiles.limitations: Service fees are market-priced. Enter the applicable station electricity and service prices. A historical government ceiling is not treated as a current station tariff.

profiles.label: Chengdu / Sichuan · enter station prices
profiles.basis: Seasonal ToU policy and 2026 electricity-market linkage
profiles.source_title: Leshan government forwarding of Sichuan 2026 ToU policy
profiles.limitations: Spring/autumn seasonal policy has peak 10:00–12:00 and 17:00–22:00, flat 08:00–10:00 and 12:00–17:00, valley 22:00–08:00. Summer/winter periods differ; 2026 market rules also affect eligible users. No single all-in Chengdu rate is asserted. Enter the station schedule and service fee; the calculator does not automatically apply seasonal policy.
